Gurgaon Police Officer Removed After Viral Video Shows Abuse of Auto Driver

A home guard with Gurgaon Police was removed from duty following a viral video that depicted him allegedly abusing an auto-rickshaw driver. The incident reportedly occurred after the driver refused to provide a free ride, stating he had a prior app booking. The video also shows the officer allegedly grabbing the driver by his hair and pushing him, leading to a debate when the driver attempted to record the incident. The driver further alleged that the officer had asked for a bribe.
